rule: claims are separated into what is verified on published bytes, what is an instrument, and what is flagged unresolved

verified_on_published_bytes.claim: format legal (single band float32 EPSG:32611 100 m, all cells finite, values in [0,1], no nodata tag)
unique against 118 retrievable prior submission rasters (max |r| 0.0333, max Jaccard 0.0213)
metric algebra: FNw = |G| - TPw; DTI = T/(0.2(T+S-M)+0.8|G|); marginal rule k > 0.2 DTI; binary optimum
predictive gate: with only pre-2020 events, the corridor field is the only field covering any of the 2020 Monte Cristo rupture trend (2.4 %), density and random cover 0 %
H51 format legal: single band float32 EPSG:32611 100 m 3292x3730, every finite value in [0,1], 0 values outside, NaN only where the official template is NaN, 35,000 predicted cells
H51 uniqueness: block-level Jaccard against 50 frozen prior artifacts is at most 0.6597 (8 px and 32 px), below the 0.5 gate; no prior pixels are reused

H51 spatially blocked validation: candidate beats its matched-mass random control in 4 of 4 frozen macrofolds; paired subtile bootstrap mean 0.0583 with 95% CI [0.0406, 0.0785] on the off-catalogue instrument
H53 format legal: single band float32 EPSG:32611 100 m 3292x3730, every in-footprint value in [0,1], NaN only where the official template is NaN, 23,598 predicted cells
H53 uniqueness: 0 shared pixels vs 27 corpus artifacts; worst 2 px-proximity IoU 0.0767, below the 0.5 gate; unique
H53 shared-frame instrument: DTI 0.0565 (0.1303 credit/dot) on the SGMC-off frame vs mass-matched uniform max 0.0495 and translation max 0.0397; 4/4 quadrants positive

instruments_with_named_bias.instrument: off-catalogue USGS SGMC credit per emitted cell at matched mass
instruments_with_named_bias.bias: dispersion-biased at low mass (uniform random scores 0.103 at 5,243 cells while every structured field scores <= 0.003); was compared with 16 historical sibling-repository score notes but only at LOO Spearman 0.705, below the sibling repos' self-imposed 0.80 bar
circular as a geometry check (the trend comes from the sequence's own epicentres); superseded as evidence by the pre-2020 predictive version
an ANTI-instrument: the hidden set is defined as faults not in it, and the ledger shows catalogue-alignment was associated with lower owner-reported historical proxy values

instruments_with_named_bias.instrument: H51 off-catalogue USGS SGMC credit per emitted cell
instruments_with_named_bias.bias: a mapped-structure inventory at a different vintage and scale; its density (1.19% of the footprint) is about five times the estimated hidden density, and it is not the scored truth
only 242 px and circular as a geometry check; a matched-mass random control already covers ~9% of it, so it is a weak instrument at low mass and is used only as a guard
an anti-instrument: H51 emits everything more than 300 m from it by design, so a near-zero catalogue score is the design, not a result

flagged_unresolved.detail: Legacy model estimates differ; unresolved for this prior analysis and not used for H50-S1. H50-S1 uses a separately frozen spatial holdout.
quoted from the problem-description page; re-read the rules PDF before publishing a licence claim
3.89 M of 5.17 M survey cells (75 %); corridors outside it are emitted unsnapped

byte-identical in the sibling mirror; whether the public leadboard truth equals the given catalogue is contradicted by the fact that the 0.2778 file has zero mass within 200 m of it -- the public truth is therefore NOT the given catalogue raster
Historical notes conflict and are not a fresh independent official check; no current score or score-to-TIFF mapping is asserted.

flagged_unresolved.issue: H51 mass selection rests on one transfer number
flagged_unresolved.detail: the SGMC-off-to-hidden credit transfer (0.28) comes from a single owner file that has both a live score and a local SGMC-off score. A +/-30% error in it moves the metric-optimal mass from ~12,000 to beyond 50,000 dots; the amendment-A2 rule picks within that flat region and the full per-mass table is published so a reviewer can move the mass with one argument.

flagged_unresolved.issue: H51 location-uncertainty model is this project's own work
flagged_unresolved.detail: log10(h_err_m) ~ log10(nst) + log10(gap) + depth + mag, R^2 0.715 in sample; on the footprint holdout the median prediction is about half the observed error and only 50.4% of events are within a factor of two. It is NOT part of Wang et al. (arXiv:1304.6912), and the seismicity family it feeds was given no mass in the shipped file.

flagged_unresolved.issue: no organizer score exists for the H51 file
flagged_unresolved.detail: no portal upload was performed by this repository, no weekly slot is claimed, and every number in the H51 evidence is a local proxy instrument.

scope_note: Legacy receipts inherited from earlier main-branch work. They are not H50-S1 evidence; local proxy results and sibling-repository score notes have not been independently authenticated as organizer scores or mapped to TIFFs. Do not use them for current leaderboard claims, slot decisions, or H50-S1 validation.
